name: Fathers
overview: Scripture reveals the vital role of fathers in nurturing and guiding their families, emphasizing honor and obedience as seen in Exodus 20:12. Fathers are called to lead their households in serving the Lord, exemplified by Joshua's declaration to serve God faithfully. The Lord's compassionate care for His children is likened to a father's pity in Psalms 103:13, highlighting the tender responsibility fathers hold. Additionally, children are described as a blessing from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), and fathers are encouraged to teach and discipline with wisdom, fostering confidence and refuge for their children as Proverbs illustrates.
